Population increased in Gravesham

The estimated population of Gravesham in 2024 was 110,671 usual residents, a rise of 1.5% since 2023.

This meant that Gravesham's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Gravesham increased by 3.5%.

Over this slightly longer period, Gravesham was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Gravesham

The average (median) age fell to 38.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Gravesham has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Gravesham is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Gravesham's population of 110,671 usual residents was made up of:

  • 23,717 people aged 0 to 15 years, (21.4%)
  • 68,234 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.7%)
  • 18,720 people aged 65 years and over, (16.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Gravesham has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (21.4% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Gravesham, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Gravesham
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Gravesham, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 369 people (0.3%). In total, there were 1,290 births and 921 deaths in Gravesham.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 56 (-0.1%). There were 6,688 people entering the area and 6,744 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Gravesham's population of 1,294 (1.2%) as a result of 1,851 people entering the area and 557 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Gravesham was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Gravesham in mid-2023 is 109,059.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 872 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 450 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,322 people.
